b_adsorption_on_empty_constant = 0.83092165595116774
a_adsorption_next_to_b_constant = 1.1163074684488037
b_adsorption_next_to_a_constant = 0.11293697279141522
a_desorption_from_single_constant = 0.11175681718105396
b_desorption_from_single_constant = 0.4148032596555416
a_desorption_from_pair_constant = 0.11463819744508015
b_desorption_from_pair_constant = 0.017958564546817716
product_formation_constant = 0.96286906706730879
a_adsorption_on_empty_rate = a_adsorption_on_empty_constant*a_concentration
b_adsorption_on_empty_rate = b_adsorption_on_empty_constant*b_concentration
a_adsorption_next_to_b_rate = a_adsorption_next_to_b_constant*a_concentration
b_adsorption_next_to_a_rate = b_adsorption_next_to_a_constant*b_concentration
a_single_exit_rate = laplace_rate + a_desorption_from_single_constant + b_adsorption_next_to_a_rate
b_single_exit_rate = laplace_rate + b_desorption_from_single_constant + a_adsorption_next_to_b_rate
paired_exit_rate = laplace_rate + product_formation_constant + a_desorption_from_pair_constant + b_desorption_from_pair_constant
paired_to_empty_ratio = (b_adsorption_next_to_a_rate*a_adsorption_on_empty_rate/a_single_exit_rate + a_adsorption_next_to_b_rate*b_adsorption_on_empty_rate/b_single_exit_rate)/(paired_exit_rate - b_adsorption_next_to_a_rate*b_desorption_from_pair_constant/a_single_exit_rate - a_adsorption_next_to_b_rate*a_desorption_from_pair_constant/b_single_exit_rate)
a_single_to_empty_ratio = (a_adsorption_on_empty_rate + b_desorption_from_pair_constant*paired_to_empty_ratio)/a_single_exit_rate
b_single_to_empty_ratio = (b_adsorption_on_empty_rate + a_desorption_from_pair_constant*paired_to_empty_ratio)/b_single_exit_rate
empty_cell_transform = laplace_rate/(laplace_rate + a_adsorption_on_empty_rate + b_adsorption_on_empty_rate - a_desorption_from_single_constant*a_single_to_empty_ratio - b_desorption_from_single_constant*b_single_to_empty_ratio - product_formation_constant*paired_to_empty_ratio)
a_occupied_transform = a_single_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
b_occupied_transform = b_single_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
ab_occupied_transform = paired_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
response = product_formation_constant*ab_occupied_transform
